title: Galois groups of quadratic polynomial iterates
abstract: Formalizes Stoll's criterion for when the Galois group of the n-th iterate of X² + a over the rationals is the full n-fold iterated wreath product of C₂. It proves the criterion in terms of two-independence of a signed critical-orbit sequence and its pairwise-coprime Möbius factors, and derives the paper's congruence families for which maximality holds at every level. The supporting library develops reusable multiquadratic-extension, iterated wreath-product, Möbius-factor, and valuation results.

informal.QuadraticIterates.section1_equiv: For each n, assuming -a is not a rational square, the Galois group of the n-th iterate of X² + a is the full n-fold iterated wreath product of C₂ exactly when either the first n terms of the signed sequence c₁ = -a, cₖ = fₖ(0) for k ≥ 2, or the first n integer Möbius factors of that sequence are independent modulo rational squares.
informal.QuadraticIterates.section1_squarefree: If -a is not a rational square and none of the absolute Möbius factors from levels 2 through n is a rational square, then the n-th iterate has the full iterated-wreath-product Galois group.
informal.QuadraticIterates.section3_main: The Galois group is the full iterated wreath product at every positive level when a is positive and congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4, or when a is negative and divisible by 4 with -a nonsquare.
